title: Dedalo FX Beat 2

x_pc.additionalInfo: 16 pattern slots (PC 0–15). PC ≥16 remapped with AND (PC 16 = PC 0, etc.). Fixed MIDI ch 10 GM drum map; TRS MIDI/SYNC auto-detect.

additionalInfo: Vendor confirms no CC parameter control. PC, notes (ch 10), clock, and transport only. Same MIDI behavior as Beat.
